findings.detail: C01 counts debt commitment rows whose source schedule explicitly has dashes for both reference rate/spread and interest rate, so the missing rates are source-faithful rather than extraction defects.

rationale: The flag is an aggregate debt-rate coverage failure: 77.18446601941747% of 206 debt rows have rates versus an 80% threshold. Raw schedule rows show debt instruments such as Dynamic Connections delayed draw and revolving credit facilities with explicit '-' in both the Reference Rate and Spread and Interest Rate columns, zero par, and small negative cost/fair value. Those blanks match the filed source, so C01 is over-scoping legitimate no-rate debt commitment rows rather than exposing a pipeline data error.
